rules.title: Short title and commencement
rules.chapter: Chapter I - Preliminary

rules.title: Definitions
rules.chapter: Chapter I - Preliminary
rules.description: Defines the terms the rest of the Rules use. Constrains how other rules are read; imposes no obligation of its own.

requirements.title: Definition of 'retail sale price'
requirements.requirement: Definitional. 'Retail sale price' means the maximum price at which the commodity in packaged form may be sold to the consumer, inclusive of all taxes. It governs how the rule 6(1)(e) declaration is read; it is not itself an obligation on a package.
requirements.verbatim_text: 'retail sale price' means the maximum price at which the commodity in packaged form may be sold to the consumer inclusive of all taxes;

requirements.title: Chapter II does not apply to bulk packages, heavy bags, or industrial and institutional supply
requirements.requirement: The declarations in Chapter II are not required at all for packages of more than 25 kg or 25 litre, for cement, fertilizer and agricultural farm produce sold in bags above 50 kg, or for packaged commodities meant for industrial or institutional consumers.
requirements.verbatim_text: The provisions of this chapter shall not apply to- (a) packages of commodities containing quantity of more than 25 kilogram or 25 litre; (b) cement, fertilizer and agricultural farm produce sold in bags above 50 kilogram; and (c) packaged commodities meant for industrial consumers or institutional consumers.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 3 of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

rules.title: Declarations to be made on every package
rules.chapter: Chapter II - Packages intended for retail sale
rules.description: Places the duty to pre-pack only with the required declarations on the packer, and extends rule 6 to every package in a promotional group.

requirements.title: No pre-packing without the required declarations
requirements.requirement: A person must not pre-pack, or permit the pre-packing of, any commodity for sale, distribution or delivery unless the package bears the declarations the Rules require.
requirements.verbatim_text: no person shall pre-pack or cause or permit to be pre-packed any commodity for sale, distribution or delivery unless the package in which the commodity is pre-packed bears thereon or on a label is securely affixed thereto, such declarations as are required to be made under these rules.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 4(1) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b). Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. A duty on the packer, discharged by complying with rules 6 onward; it adds no declaration this system could check independently, so checking it IS checking rule 6. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING; 2022-2025 amendment-chain gap applies.

requirements.title: Every package in a promotional group must comply with rule 6
requirements.requirement: Where packages intended for retail sale are grouped together to be sold as one retail package on a promotional offer, every package in the group must comply with rule 6 - not merely the outer group.
requirements.verbatim_text: When one or more packages intended for retail sale are grouped together for being sold as a retail package on promotional offer, every package of the group shall comply with provisions of rule 6.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 4(2) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/INVENTORY.md, recorded as substituted vide G.S.R. 779(E) with commencement deferred to 1 October 2022 by G.S.R. 226(E). Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. rules.title: Declarations to be made on every package
rules.chapter: Chapter II - Packages intended for retail sale
rules.description: The core labelling rule. Lists the declarations every retail package must bear, the consumer-care details, the treatment of stickers and multi-component packages, the e-commerce obligations, and the unit sale price.
rules.notes: The rule this system evaluates most of, and still only in part. As of Step 3 the clauses with executable coverage are 6(1)(a) and 6(1)(aa) (presence), 6(1)(c) (presence), 6(1)(d) (presence, and whether a month and year can be established), 6(1)(e) (presence, and whether the price is declared exclusive of all taxes) and 6(2) (presence, and the telephone and e-mail elements). Every other clause remains blocked by applicability data, extraction capability, or the absence of a visual check type - and every clause listed here is covered only to the extent its rule file records.

requirements.title: Declarations must be definite, plain and conspicuous
requirements.requirement: Every package must bear, on it or on a label securely affixed to it, a definite, plain and conspicuous declaration of the matters listed in the clauses of rule 6(1).
requirements.verbatim_text: Every package shall bear thereon or on label securely affixed thereto, a definite, plain and conspicuous declaration made in accordance with the provisions of this chapter as, to-
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(1) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, opening words
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/SOURCES.md and rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b). Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. 'Definite, plain and conspicuous' is a presentation standard: CheckContext.image and ExtractedLabelField.bounding_box supply the inputs, but no visual_check is registered. ALSO A LEGAL-REVIEW ITEM - what counts as 'conspicuous' has no threshold in the Rules and none may be invented; rules/INVENTORY.md directs that it be approached through rules 7 and 8, which are measurable, rather than on its own. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

requirements.title: Name and address of the manufacturer, packer or importer
requirements.requirement: The package must state the name and address of the manufacturer. Where the manufacturer is not the packer, it must state the name and address of both the manufacturer and the packer. For an imported package, it must state the name and address of the importer.
requirements.verbatim_text: the name and address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer and for any imported package the name and address of the importer shall be mentioned.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(a) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/SOURCES.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b). Explanation III, as substituted vide G.S.R. 629(E) dated 23 June 2017 w.e.f. 1 January 2018, reads verbatim: 'In respect of packages containing food articles, the provisions of this clause shall not apply, but the provisions of, and the requirements specified in the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (34 of 2006) and the rules made thereunder shall apply;'. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. THE CLAUSE IS DISJUNCTIVE and no registered check can test a disjunction of field keys, which is why LM-PC-0001 ships is_active:false - a single-key check would report a lawfully labelled imported package as non-compliant. The address half is additionally blocked: manufacturer_address is in the extractor's UNSUPPORTED_KEYS, and rule 10(1) is the operative address provision. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING; 2022-2025 amendment-chain gap applies. STEP 2: this clause is now EVALUATED - see the rule file(s) named in compliance_rule_codes for exactly what is and is not tested. Applicability is resolved before the validator runs, so a package the clause excuses is recorded NOT_APPLICABLE and one whose exempting facts were never declared reaches REVIEW_REQUIRED.

applicability.note: Explanation III: this clause does not apply to packages containing food articles, for which the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 applies instead. Encoded on LM-PC-0001 by targeting packaged-non-food only.
For an imported package the clause requires the importer's name and address.

requirements.title: Country of origin for imported products
requirements.requirement: For imported products, the package must state the name of the country of origin, or of manufacture, or of assembly.
requirements.verbatim_text: The name of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly in case of imported products shall be mentioned on the package;
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(aa) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/SOURCES.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b), recorded as inserted vide G.S.R. 629(E) w.e.f. 1 January 2018. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. THE EVIDENCE IS AVAILABLE - country_of_origin is in the extractor's supported set - BUT THE TRIGGER IS NOT: import status is not a ProductCategory and is recorded nowhere. rules/INVENTORY.md calls this the closest requirement in the Rules to implementable: it needs one applicability input, not a new check type. Import status must NOT be inferred from the presence of importer_name, which would make the rule self-fulfilling. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING. STEP 2: this clause is now EVALUATED - see the rule file(s) named in compliance_rule_codes for exactly what is and is not tested. Applicability is resolved before the validator runs, so a package the clause excuses is recorded NOT_APPLICABLE and one whose exempting facts were never declared reaches REVIEW_REQUIRED.

applicability.note: Applies to imported products only.

requirements.title: Common or generic name of the commodity
requirements.requirement: The package must state the common or generic name of the commodity it contains. Where the package holds more than one product, it must state the name and the number or quantity of each product.
requirements.verbatim_text: The common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package and in case of packages with more than one product, the name and number or quantity of each product shall be mentioned on the package.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(b) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/SOURCES.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b), which records no proviso, explanation or exemption attaching to this clause. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. THE LEGAL REQUIREMENT IS NOT IN DOUBT; the extraction is. common_or_generic_name is in the extractor's UNSUPPORTED_KEYS, so its absence carries no information about the package, and LM-PC-0002 ships is_active:false as a containment measure after it was found to report a violation against every readable label. Detection is ocr_cv, not ocr, because the declaration is identified by layout - it is the largest text on the front panel - and the keyword anchor a pattern layer could use appears on 1 of 28 frozen evaluation panels. Reactivating needs measured extraction recall, not a legal decision. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

requirements.title: Net quantity
requirements.requirement: The package must state the net quantity of the commodity in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure; or, where the commodity is packed or sold by number, the number of items in the package.
requirements.verbatim_text: The net quantity, in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, of the commodity contained in the package or where the commodity is packed or sold by number, the number of the commodity contained in the package shall be mentioned.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(c) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/SOURCES.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b), which records no proviso, explanation or exemption attaching to this clause. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. EVALUATED by LM-PC-0003, and the ONLY part evaluated is PRESENCE: whether the quantity is correctly expressed is rules 11 to 13, and whether it is TRUE requires weighing the goods, which is rules 19-23 and outside this system entirely. The rule 3 and rule 26 scope gates still over-apply it. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING; 2022-2025 amendment-chain gap applies.

requirements.title: Month and year of manufacture
requirements.requirement: The package must state the month and year in which the commodity was manufactured. The words 'or pre-packed or imported' were omitted from this clause, so the clause in force covers manufacture only.
requirements.verbatim_text: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported shall be mentioned in the package:
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(d) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: verbatim_text is the clause AS PRINTED in the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b), which carries the annotation: 'the words, - "or pre-packed or imported" shall be omitted vide GSR 779(E) dated 2nd November, 2021 w.e.f. 1.4.2022 (now w.e.f 01.10.2022 vide GSR 226(E) dated 28.3.2022).' The struck words are LEFT IN verbatim_text because that is what the source prints; the operative reading - manufacture only - is stated in 'requirement' instead of silently editing a quotation. STEP 3: LM-PC-0011 additionally checks that the declaration RESOLVES to a month and a year. NO PRINTED FORMAT IS ENFORCED - the clause prescribes none, and none is invented; a reading that cannot be resolved, such as an ambiguous 03/04/2025 where the year is settled but the month is not, is REVIEW_REQUIRED and never a violation. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. LM-PC-0004 shipped is_active:false because the food carve-out was expressible but cosmetics, seeds, bidi, incense sticks and LPG cylinders all sat inside packaged-non-food with no narrower category; that is superseded by the STEP 2 note below. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING; 2022-2025 amendment-chain gap applies. STEP 2: this clause is now EVALUATED - see the rule file(s) named in compliance_rule_codes for exactly what is and is not tested. Applicability is resolved before the validator runs, so a package the clause excuses is recorded NOT_APPLICABLE and one whose exempting facts were never declared reaches REVIEW_REQUIRED.

applicability.note: Food articles are governed by the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Seeds labelled and certified under the Seeds Act, 1966 are excluded.
Cosmetics products are governed by the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945.
Proviso (A)(i): no declaration as to month and year is required on any package containing bidi or incense sticks.
Proviso (A)(i).
Proviso (A)(ii): any domestic liquefied petroleum gas cylinder of 14.2kg or 5kg, bottled and marketed by a public sector undertaking.

requirements.title: Best before or use by date
requirements.requirement: Where a package contains a commodity that may become unfit for human consumption after a period of time, the label must also state the 'best before or use by' date, month and year. The clause does not apply if another law makes provision in this regard.
requirements.verbatim_text: If a package contains a commodity which may become unfit for human consumption after a period of time, the 'best before or use by the date, month and year' shall also be mentioned on the label: Provided that nothing in this clause shall apply if a provision in this regard is made in any other law.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(da) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/SOURCES.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b), recorded as substituted vide G.S.R. 629(E) w.e.f. 1 January 2018. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. best_before is extracted, but the TRIGGER is a property of the commodity - 'may become unfit for human consumption after a period of time' - that the system does not record. rules/INVENTORY.md warns that packaged-food is NOT a safe proxy: salt and sugar are food, and many non-foods perish. The second proviso, displacement by any other law, is a further legal-review question. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

applicability.note: Triggered by the commodity being one that may become unfit for human consumption after a period of time.

requirements.title: Retail sale price
requirements.requirement: The package must state the retail sale price, clearly indicated as the maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes, in Indian currency.
requirements.verbatim_text: the retail sale price of the package; ... shall clearly indicate that it is the maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes in Indian currency:
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(e) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Both fragments quoted verbatim in rules/SOURCES.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b); the second was substituted vide G.S.R. 629(E) w.e.f. 1 January 2018 and further amended vide G.S.R. 779(E) / G.S.R. 226(E), giving the current wording w.e.f. 1 October 2022. The ellipsis marks the join between the clause and the substituted words as the source presents them, not an omission of qualifying text. Read with rule 2(m). Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. LM-PC-0005 shipped is_active:false for two reasons - bidi, LPG and alcohol were not separable in the taxonomy, and 'clearly indicate ... inclusive of all taxes in Indian currency' is a FORMAT requirement field_presence cannot express; the first is superseded by the STEP 2 note below and the second is partly addressed by the STEP 3 note. STEP 3: LM-PC-0012 reports a price the label declares EXCLUSIVE of all taxes, which contradicts this clause read with rule 2(m). NOTHING WIDER IS DECIDED. The ABSENCE of an 'inclusive of all taxes' indication is recorded in the finding but is NOT treated as a violation, because whether printing 'MRP' alone already clearly indicates tax inclusion - rule 2(m) defines the term as inclusive - is a question of legal construction this system does not settle. 'In Indian currency' is not checked at all: the normaliser writes the currency as a fixed default rather than reading it off the label, so testing the clause against it would be testing our own default. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING; 2022-2025 amendment-chain gap applies. STEP 2: this clause is now EVALUATED - see the rule file(s) named in compliance_rule_codes for exactly what is and is not tested. Applicability is resolved before the validator runs, so a package the clause excuses is recorded NOT_APPLICABLE and one whose exempting facts were never declared reaches REVIEW_REQUIRED.

applicability.note: Proviso (C)(i): no declaration as to retail sale price is required on any package containing bidi.
Proviso (C)(ii): any domestic LPG cylinder of which the price is covered under the Administrative Price Mechanism of the Government.
State Excise Laws apply within the State of manufacture; these Rules apply only where those laws do not provide for declaration of retail sale price.

requirements.title: Dimensions where the sizes of the commodity are relevant
requirements.requirement: Where the sizes of the commodity in the package are relevant, the package must state the dimensions of the commodity; and where the dimensions of different pieces differ, the dimensions of each such piece.
requirements.verbatim_text: Where the sizes of the commodity contained in the package are relevant, the dimensions of the commodity contained in the package and if the dimensions of the different pieces are different, the dimensions of each such different piece shall be mentioned.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(f) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/SOURCES.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b). Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. BOTH the trigger and the evidence are missing: 'relevant' is undefined in the Rules and rules 14-17 specify where it bites, and there is no LabelFieldKey for dimensions. NOTE: the branch brief for this project once cited 6(1)(f) for consumer-care details. That is wrong - 6(1)(f) is this dimensions clause and consumer care is rule 6(2). HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

applicability.note: Applies only where the sizes of the commodity are relevant.

requirements.title: Such other matter as is specified in these rules
requirements.requirement: A pointer to the other declarations the Rules specify. It creates no declaration of its own; its content is the other rules in this framework.
requirements.verbatim_text: such other matter as are specified in these rules:
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(g) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/SOURCES.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b). Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. Recorded so the clause list of rule 6(1) is complete and (g) is not mistaken for a missing entry. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

requirements.title: Carry-over of pre-printed packaging material into the next month
requirements.requirement: Packaging material pre-printed with a month, not exhausted during that month, may be used for pre-packing the commodity produced in the next succeeding month and no later. A proviso excludes food products whose 'best before' or 'use before' period is ninety days or less.
requirements.verbatim_text: where any packaging material bearing thereon the month in which any commodity was expected to have been pre-packed is not exhausted during that month, such packaging material may be used for pre-packing the concerned commodity produced or manufactured during the next succeeding month and not there after...
requirements.legal_reference: Proviso (B) to rule 6(1) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted as far as reproduced in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b); the trailing ellipsis is INVENTORY's own, marking text not transcribed there, and the remainder has not been read. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. A permission about manufacturing practice over time, not a declaration on a package, and unverifiable from one photograph. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

requirements.title: Consumer care details
requirements.requirement: Every package must bear the name, address, telephone number and e-mail address of the person, or of the office, that can be contacted in case of consumer complaints.
requirements.verbatim_text: Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number, e-mail address of the person who can be or the office which can be contacted, in case of consumer complaints.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(2) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/SOURCES.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b), recorded as substituted vide G.S.R. 385(E) dated 14 May 2015, effective 1 January 2016 (the source records 'dispensed upto 30.6.2016'). Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. EVALUATED by LM-PC-0006 (presence) and, since STEP 3, by LM-PC-0010 (elements). LM-PC-0010 checks TWO of the four elements the clause names - the TELEPHONE NUMBER and the E-MAIL ADDRESS - and reports precisely which is missing. THE NAME AND THE ADDRESS OF THE PERSON OR OFFICE TO BE CONTACTED REMAIN UNCHECKED: the extractor reads no consumer-care name, and it does not read addresses at all, rule 10(1) being the operative address provision. So the clause is now partly, not wholly, evaluated, and every finding says so. THIS IS RULE 6(2), NOT RULE 6(1)(f): the branch brief cited 6(1)(f), which is the dimensions clause. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING; 2022-2025 amendment-chain gap applies.

requirements.title: Stickers may not alter a required declaration
requirements.requirement: Individual stickers must not be affixed to a package to alter or make a declaration required by the Rules. A sticker showing a revised LOWER maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes is permitted, and must not cover the MRP declared by the manufacturer or packer.
requirements.verbatim_text: It shall not be permissible to affix individual stickers on the package for altering or making declaration required under these rules: Provided that for reducing the Maximum Retail Price (MRP), a sticker with the revised lower MRP (inclusive of all taxes) may be affixed and the same shall not cover the MRP declaration made by the manufacturer or the packer...
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(3) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted as far as reproduced in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b); the trailing ellipsis is INVENTORY's own. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. Recorded because it is a real and commonly contravened obligation, but detecting an overlaid sticker from a photograph is a RESEARCH PROBLEM, not a check-type gap - the honest classification is partially_automatable at best, and it must not be attempted with a presence check. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

requirements.title: Permitted additional declarations
requirements.requirement: Permissive. A manufacturer, packer or importer may declare a barcode, GTIN or QR code, an e-code, and logos of Government schemes in addition to the mandatory declarations.
requirements.verbatim_text: Nothing in this rule shall preclude a manufacturer or packer or importer to declare the following on the package, in addition to the mandatory declarations- (a) Barcode or GTIN or QR Code; (b) 'e-code' ... (c) logos of Government schemes...
requirements.legal_reference: Rules 6(4) and 6(4A) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted as reproduced in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b); the ellipses are INVENTORY's own. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. PERMISSIVE - there is nothing here a package can fail. Recorded so that the presence of a QR code or a scheme logo is never mistaken for a contravention. requirements.title: Multi-component packages
requirements.requirement: Where a commodity consists of several components packed in two or more units for sale as a single commodity, the rule 6(1) declarations must appear on the main package, which must also carry information about the accompanying packages.
requirements.verbatim_text: Where a commodity consists of a number of components and these components are packed in two or more units, for sale as a single commodity, the declaration required to be made under sub-rule (1) shall appear on the main package and such package shall also carry information about the other accompanying packages...
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(5) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted as far as reproduced in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b); the trailing ellipsis is INVENTORY's own. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. Requires knowing that a submission is a multi-unit commodity AND which photograph is the main package. Neither is modelled. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

applicability.note: Applies where a commodity's components are packed in two or more units for sale as a single commodity.

requirements.title: Exhaustion of old wrappers (spent)
requirements.requirement: A transitional permission that expired. It imposes no present obligation.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(6) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

Long spent.' verbatim_text IS DELIBERATELY EMPTY: the clause itself is not transcribed in the project's material, only its effect and expiry, and a quotation must never be reconstructed from a summary. effective_to is the expiry date the source states. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

requirements.title: 'GM' declaration on genetically modified food
requirements.requirement: Every package containing genetically modified food must bear the words 'GM' at the top of its principal display panel.
requirements.verbatim_text: Every package containing the genetically modified food shall bear at the top of its principle display panel the words 'GM'.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(7) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b), including the source's own spelling 'principle display panel', reproduced as printed. Recorded as inserted vide G.S.R. 427(E) w.e.f. 1 January 2013. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. Blocked twice over: whether a food is genetically modified is not knowable from a photograph, and 'at the top of the principal display panel' needs PDP geometry. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

applicability.note: Applies to packages containing genetically modified food.

requirements.title: Vegetarian / non-vegetarian mark on cosmetics and toiletries
requirements.requirement: Every package containing soaps, shampoos, toothpastes and other cosmetics and toiletries must bear at the top of its principal display panel a red or brown dot for products of non-vegetarian origin, and a green dot for products of vegetarian origin.
requirements.verbatim_text: Every package containing soaps, shampoos, tooth pastes and other cosmetics and toiletries shall bear at the top of its principal display panel a red or, as the case may be, brown dot for products of non-vegetarian origin and a green dot for products of vegetarian origin.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(8) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b), recorded as inserted vide G.S.R. 137 dated 15 June 2014 w.e.f. 1 July 2014. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. Needs a cosmetics/toiletries category, colour detection and PDP geometry. rules/INVENTORY.md notes it as a requirement a visual check could GENUINELY reach once the category exists - the colour test is objective, unlike 'conspicuous'. Whether the product is of vegetarian origin is a separate fact the mark asserts and this system cannot verify. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

applicability.note: Applies to soaps, shampoos, toothpastes and other cosmetics and toiletries.

requirements.title: Labels permitted on imported packages
requirements.requirement: Permissive. It is permissible to affix a label on an imported package to make the declarations the Rules require.
requirements.verbatim_text: it shall be permissible to affix a label on imported packages for making the declarations required under these rules.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(9) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b). Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. PERMISSIVE - nothing to fail. Recorded so that a declaration appearing on an affixed label rather than printed on an imported package is never treated as a defect. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

applicability.note: Concerns imported packages.

requirements.title: Mandatory declarations on e-commerce listings
requirements.requirement: An e-commerce entity must ensure that the mandatory declarations - except the month and year of manufacture or packing - are displayed on the digital and electronic network used for the e-commerce transaction.
requirements.verbatim_text: An E-Commerce entity shall ensure that the mandatory declarations ... except the month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or packed, shall be displayed on the digital and electronic network used for e-commerce transactions
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(10) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted as reproduced in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b); the internal ellipsis is INVENTORY's own. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. AN OBLIGATION ON A LISTING, NOT ON A PACKAGE. This system analyses photographs of physical packages, so evaluating it would need the listing page as an input - a different pipeline, not a different check type. Recorded rather than omitted because a reader will look for it. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

applicability.note: Binds an e-commerce entity in respect of its listing.

requirements._comment: THE VERSIONED CLAUSE. Two versions of 6(10A) coexist: inserted by G.S.R. 128(E) w.e.f. 1 July 2026, then substituted by G.S.R. 312(E) w.e.f. 1 July 2027. Both notifications were retrieved and read in full. The TRANSITION between them is flagged requires_review and effective_to on version 1 is left NULL - see its source_note.
requirements.title: Country-of-origin filter on e-commerce listings (as inserted, 2026)
requirements.requirement: An e-commerce entity offering an imported product for sale must provide a country-of-origin filter on the product listing. THE EXACT WORDING OF THIS VERSION HAS NOT BEEN TRANSCRIBED - see source_note.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(10A) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, as inserted by G.S.R. 128(E)
requirements.source_note: G.S.R. 128(E) dated 13 February 2026 was RETRIEVED DIRECTLY AND READ IN FULL on 2026-08-30 by Claude Code (automated legal-source check) for raghavrrrao (see rules/SOURCES.md). It is recorded there as inserting rule 6(10A) only - a country-of-origin filter on e-commerce listings - in force 1 July 2026, and as NOT amending rule 6(1)(a)-(g) or rule 6(2). TWO THINGS ARE DELIBERATELY NOT ASSERTED. First, verbatim_text is EMPTY: rules/SOURCES.md records the EFFECT of this notification but does not transcribe the inserted clause, and a quotation must not be reconstructed from a description. The 'requirement' text above is therefore a summary of that recorded effect, not a reading of the clause. Second, effective_to is NULL: G.S.R. 312(E) substitutes this clause with effect from 1 July 2027, but neither notification states in terms when THIS version ceases to apply, and the natural inference - that it runs to 30 June 2027 - is an interpretation the sources do not establish. Setting that date would be inventing a transition. CONSEQUENCE: on and after 1 July 2027 BOTH versions of 6(10A) satisfy is_in_force_on(), which is the correct representation of an unresolved transition and is why this row is flagged requires_review rather than verified. A NAMED HUMAN REVIEWER MUST RESOLVE THE TRANSITION AND TRANSCRIBE THE CLAUSE.

applicability.note: Binds an e-commerce entity in respect of its listing.
Applies in respect of imported products offered for sale.

requirements.title: Country-of-origin filter on e-commerce listings (as substituted, 2027)
requirements.requirement: Every e-commerce entity offering any imported product for sale must ensure, with effect from 1 July 2027, that the product listing contains a searchable and sortable filter specifying the country of origin.
requirements.verbatim_text: Every e-commerce entity offering for sale any imported product shall, with effect from the 1st day of July, 2027, ensure that the product listing of such imported product contains a searchable and sortable filter specifying the country of origin.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(10A) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, as substituted by G.S.R. 312(E)
requirements.source_note: G.S.R. 312(E) dated 27 April 2026 was RETRIEVED DIRECTLY AND READ IN FULL on 2026-08-30 by Claude Code (automated legal-source check) for raghavrrrao (see rules/SOURCES.md). In force 1 July 2027; substitutes rule 6(10A) only; confirmed NOT to amend rule 6(1)(a)-(g) or rule 6(2). The verbatim_text above is quoted in rules/INVENTORY.md. THE CLAUSE TEXT IS VERIFIED; THE STATUS IS requires_review BECAUSE OF THE TRANSITION, not the wording: version 1 has no stated end date, so the two versions overlap from 1 July 2027 in this framework's representation. That overlap is deliberate and honest - see version 1's source_note. A named human reviewer must resolve it. Note also the fourteen months between notification (27 April 2026) and commencement (1 July 2027): a caller asking what rule 6(10A) requires MUST pass the date it cares about.

applicability.note: Binds an e-commerce entity in respect of its listing.
Applies to any imported product offered for sale.

requirements.title: Unit sale price
requirements.requirement: The unit sale price must be declared in the prescribed form, which depends on the net-quantity band of the commodity. It is not required where the retail sale price equals the unit sale price.
requirements.verbatim_text: The unit sale price shall be declared as- (i) 'Rs. _ per g' for pre-packaged commodities with net quantity of commodity ... Provided further that declaration of unit sale price is not required for the pre-packaged commodities in which retail sale price is equal to the unit sale price.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(11) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted as reproduced in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b); the internal ellipsis is INVENTORY's own, standing for the per-band table not transcribed there. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. NOTE IT IS RULE 6(11), NOT A CLAUSE OF RULE 6(1) - a common mis-citation. The extractor now ATTEMPTS unit_sale_price, but attempted is not reliable: the key postdates the frozen evaluation set, so NO precision or recall figure exists for it. The requirement remains unevaluable regardless, because deciding the required FORM needs the net-quantity band and the exemption is an arithmetic comparison, and neither format_check nor numeric_check is registered. The status line is the rules owner's to re-decide, and was not re-decided by extraction work. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

rules.title: Principal display panel - area, and size of numerals and letters
rules.chapter: Chapter II - Packages intended for retail sale
rules.description: Fixes the minimum height of numerals and letters against bands of principal-display-panel area, and the minimum width as a proportion of height.
rules.notes: rules/INVENTORY.md calls this the most tractable of the visual requirements: Table-I is objective and numeric, and bounding boxes plus the source image supply the geometry. What it still lacks is PDP area - rule 7(4) gives a formula per package shape, which needs the shape - and a real millimetre scale, which a photograph does not carry.

requirements.title: Minimum height and width of numerals and letters on the principal display panel
requirements.requirement: The height of numerals and letters in a declaration must meet the minimum in Table-I for the area band of the principal display panel, and the width of a letter or numeral must be at least one third of its height, except for the numeral '1' and the letters (i), (I) and ().
requirements.verbatim_text: The width of the letter or numeral shall not be less than one third of its height, except in the case of numeral '1' and letters (i), ( I) and ( );
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 7 of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: The quotation is rule 7(3), verbatim in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b); Table-I itself, which fixes minimum heights against PDP area bands, is NOT transcribed and must be read from the source before any threshold is coded. Recorded as substituted vide G.S.R. 629(E) w.e.f. 1 January 2018, with Table-I corrected by G.S.R. 1373(E) dated 7 November 2017. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. THE ONE-THIRD RATIO IS SCALE-FREE and therefore computable from bounding boxes alone; the Table-I heights are NOT, because they are absolute measurements and a photograph carries no millimetre scale. The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2025 additionally make the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 prevail for medical devices - and that instrument is known only from a PIB release, so its effect here is unverified. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

applicability.note: Per the PIB release for the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2025, the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 prevail for the height and width of numerals and letters for medical devices. RECORDED FROM A PRESS RELEASE, NOT THE GAZETTE - see that instrument's verification_note.

rules.title: Declarations to appear on the principal display panel
rules.chapter: Chapter II - Packages intended for retail sale
rules.description: Requires every declaration to appear on the principal display panel, and fixes a clear space around the quantity declaration in multiples of the numeral height.

requirements.title: Declarations on the principal display panel, with clear space around the quantity
requirements.requirement: Every declaration required by the Rules must appear on the principal display panel. The area around the quantity declaration must be free of printed information: above and below by at least the height of the numeral, and to the left and right by at least twice that height.
requirements.verbatim_text: Every declaration required to be made under these rules shall appear on the principal display panel. Provided that the area surrounding the quantity declaration shall be free from printed information. (a) above and below by a space equal to at least the height of the numeral in the declaration, and (b) to the left and right by a space at least twice the height of numeral in the declaration.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 8(1) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b). Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. THE CLEAR-SPACE PROVISO IS EXPRESSED PURELY IN MULTIPLES OF THE NUMERAL HEIGHT, so it is computable from bounding boxes with no millimetre scale - INVENTORY calls it arguably the single most implementable visual requirement in the Rules. What remains open is identifying WHICH face is the principal display panel, which no current input settles. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

rules.title: Manner in which declarations are to be made
rules.chapter: Chapter II - Packages intended for retail sale
rules.description: How declarations must be presented: legible and prominent, in a contrasting colour, not read through a liquid, repeated on an outer wrapper, and in Hindi or English.

requirements.title: Declarations must be legible and prominent
requirements.requirement: Every declaration required on a package must be legible and prominent.
requirements.verbatim_text: Every declaration which is required to be made on a package under these rules shall be -- (a) legible and prominent;
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 9(1)(a) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/SOURCES.md and rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b). Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. DETECTION IS RECORDED AS manual_review DELIBERATELY, although the raw inputs exist: the Rules set NO numeric threshold for 'legible and prominent', so implementing it directly would mean INVENTING a threshold, which is precisely what this project forbids. rules/INVENTORY.md directs that it be approached through rules 7 and 8, which supply measurable proxies, and never on its own. Implementing this clause with a presence check would silently answer a different question. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

requirements.title: Price and quantity numerals in a contrasting colour
requirements.requirement: The numerals of the retail sale price and the net quantity declaration must be printed, painted or inscribed in a colour that contrasts conspicuously with the background of the label, subject to provisos for blown, formed or moulded information and for hand-written declarations.
requirements.verbatim_text: numerals of the retail sale price and net quantity declaration shall be printed, painted or inscribed on the package in a colour that contrasts conspicuously with the background of the label
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 9(1)(b) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b); the provisos for blown/formed/moulded information and for hand-written declarations are recorded there but not transcribed. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. Contrast IS measurable from pixels within a bounding box - but 'contrasts conspicuously' has NO numeric threshold in the Rules, so this is also a legal-review item and no contrast figure may be adopted without one. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

requirements.title: A declaration must not have to be read through a liquid
requirements.requirement: No declaration may be made so as to require it to be read through any liquid commodity contained in the package.
requirements.verbatim_text: No declaration shall be made so as to require it to be read through any liquid commodity contained in the package.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 9(2) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b). Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. Would require inferring package construction from an image. Recorded for completeness; also a legal-review item. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

requirements.title: Declarations on an outer container or wrapper
requirements.requirement: Where a package has an outer container or wrapper, that container or wrapper must also carry all the declarations required on the package - unless it is transparent and the declarations on the package are easily readable through it. No declaration is required on the inner package if the outer package carries all of them.
requirements.verbatim_text: Where a package is provided with an outside container or wrapper such container or wrapper shall also contain all the declarations which are required to appear on the package except where such container or wrapper itself is transparent and the declarations on the package itself are easily readable through such outside wrapper. Provided that no such declarations on the inner package is required, if the outer package contains all declarations required under these rules.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 9(3) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b). Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. Needs to know whether the photographed item is an inner or an outer package. Not modelled. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

applicability.note: Applies where a package is provided with an outside container or wrapper.

requirements.title: Language of the declarations
requirements.requirement: The particulars of the declarations must be either in Hindi in Devanagari script or in English. Any other language may be used in addition.
requirements.verbatim_text: The particulars of the declarations required to be specified under this rule on a package shall either be in Hindi in Devnagri script or in English: Provided that nothing contained in this sub-rule shall prevent the use of any other language in addition to Hindi or English language.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 9(4) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b), including the source's spelling 'Devnagri'. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. Script detection is tractable, BUT THE OCR IS ENGLISH-ONLY: a wholly Hindi label would currently read as UNREADABLE rather than as compliant, and reporting that as a violation would be exactly backwards. MUST NOT BE ATTEMPTED before the extractor handles Devanagari. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

rules.title: Name and address of the manufacturer, packer or importer
rules.chapter: Chapter II - Packages intended for retail sale
rules.description: The operative provision for the completeness of the address, and for the name being the actual corporate name.

requirements.title: Name and complete address, conspicuously
requirements.requirement: Every package must bear conspicuously the name and complete address of the manufacturer; where the manufacturer is not the packer, of the manufacturer and the packer; and for imported packages, of the importer. A proviso applies to packages of 10 cubic centimetres or less, and Explanation 1 defines 'complete address'.
requirements.verbatim_text: Subject to the provisions of rule 6, every package ... shall bear conspicuously on it, the name and complete address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and the packer and in case of imported packages, the name and address of the importer
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 10(1) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted as reproduced in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b); the internal ellipsis is INVENTORY's own, and neither the 10-cubic-centimetre proviso nor Explanation 1's definition of 'complete address' is transcribed there. Recorded as substituted vide G.S.R. 629(E) w.e.f. 1 January 2018. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. THIS IS THE OPERATIVE ADDRESS PROVISION that rule 6(1)(a) refers to, and manufacturer_address is in the extractor's UNSUPPORTED_KEYS - the extractor explicitly does not read addresses. The 10-cubic-centimetre proviso additionally needs package capacity, which is not recorded. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

applicability.note: For imported packages the clause requires the importer's name and address.

requirements.title: The name must be the actual corporate name
requirements.requirement: The name of the manufacturer, packer or importer must be the actual corporate name, or - if not incorporated - the name under which the business is conducted in India.
requirements.verbatim_text: The name of the manufacturer or packer or importer shall be the actual corporate name, or if not incorporated, the name under which the business is conducted by such manufacturer or packer or importer in India.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 10(2) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b). Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. Verifying that a printed name IS the actual corporate name requires a companies register, not a photograph. Detection is recorded as 'database' rather than 'not_applicable' because the fact does exist in a register somewhere - it is simply not reachable from here. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

rules.title: General provisions relating to the declaration of quantity
rules.chapter: Chapter II - Packages intended for retail sale
rules.description: Excludes wrappers from the net quantity, and prohibits qualifying the declaration with words such as 'when packed' except for Third Schedule commodities.

requirements.title: Wrappers and other materials excluded from the net quantity
requirements.requirement: In declaring the net quantity, the weight of wrappers and of materials other than the commodity must be excluded.
requirements.verbatim_text: In declaring the net quantity of the commodity contained in a package, the weight of wrappers and materials other than the commodity shall be excluded.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 11(1) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted verbatim in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b). Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. REQUIRES WEIGHING THE GOODS AND THE WRAPPER SEPARATELY. No image establishes it, and no confidence score changes that. This is a clear case for REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than any verdict. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

requirements.title: Quantity must not be qualified by 'when packed' or the like
requirements.requirement: The declaration of quantity must not be qualified by the words 'when packed' or the like, except for commodities specified in the Third Schedule, which may be so qualified.
requirements.legal_reference: Rules 11(2), 11(3) and 11(4) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: rules/INVENTORY.md records these sub-rules together, stating that the declaration 'shall not be qualified by the words "when packed" or the like' and that 11(4) permits Third Schedule commodities to be so qualified. verbatim_text IS EMPTY: INVENTORY summarises 11(2)/(3)/(4) rather than quoting them in full, and a quotation must not be assembled from a summary - the phrase in quotation marks above appears in the summary and is reproduced only inside this note. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. Detecting the qualifier in a net-quantity string is a straightforward text check once format_check exists, but knowing whether the commodity is in the Third Schedule is missing applicability data, so the exception cannot be honoured. A NAMED REVIEWER SHOULD TRANSCRIBE 11(2)-(4) BEFORE THIS IS IMPLEMENTED.

applicability.note: Rule 11(4): commodities in the Third Schedule may qualify the declaration.

rules.title: Manner in which the quantity is to be declared
rules.chapter: Chapter II - Packages intended for retail sale
rules.description: Prescribes the unit of declaration by the physical state of the commodity, prohibits misleading expressions of quantity, and allows a tag or card for very small packages.

requirements.title: Unit of declaration follows the physical state of the commodity
requirements.requirement: Quantity must be declared in units of mass for solid, semi-solid and viscous commodities; of length; of area; of volume; or by number, according to the nature of the commodity.
requirements.verbatim_text: the declaration of quantity shall be in terms of the unit of - (a) mass, if the commodity is solid, semi-solid, viscous ...; (b) length ...; (c) area ...; (d) volume ...; or (e) number ...
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 12(2) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted as reproduced in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b); the ellipses are INVENTORY's own and the clause bodies are not transcribed in full. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. Requires knowing whether the commodity is solid, liquid, or sold by number - a fact about the CONTENTS, not the label, and not recorded. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.

applicability.note: Which unit is required depends on the physical state of the commodity.

requirements.title: No misleading or exaggerated expression of quantity
requirements.requirement: The declaration of quantity must not contain any word or expression that creates, or is likely to create, an exaggerated, misleading or inadequate impression as to the quantity.
requirements.verbatim_text: shall not contain any word or expression ... which tends to create or is likely to create an exaggerated, misleading or inadequate expression as to the quantity
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 12(6) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

rules.title: Power to relax
rules.chapter: Chapter VII - General
rules.description: Empowers the Central Government to relax one or more provisions of the Rules for a reasonable period, with specified corrective measures.
rules.notes: THE MOST IMPORTANT RULE IN THIS FRAMEWORK FOR INTERPRETING ANY OUTPUT. A relaxation granted under rule 33 makes an otherwise-correct finding wrong, and this system has no way to know one exists. Every finding it produces is conditional on no relaxation applying.

requirements.title: Central Government may relax provisions of the Rules
requirements.requirement: The Central Government may permit a manufacturer or packer to pack for sale for a reasonable period by relaxing one or more provisions of the Rules, with such corrective measures as may be specified.
requirements.verbatim_text: The Central Government may ... permit a manufacturer or packer to pack for sale the packages for a reasonable period by relaxing one or more provision of these Rules with such corrective measures as may be specified.
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 33 of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
requirements.source_note: Quoted as reproduced in rules/INVENTORY.md from the Department's consolidated publication (sha256 0ef948f9...f983a4b); the internal ellipsis is INVENTORY's own. Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code for raghavrrrao. INVENTORY states the consequence directly: 'A relaxation granted under rule 33 makes an otherwise-correct finding wrong. The system has no way to know one exists. Every finding it produces is therefore conditional on no relaxation applying - a caveat that belongs in the user-facing output, not only here.' Severity is 'critical' for that reason: it qualifies every other finding. The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2025 further provide that rule 33 relaxations do not apply where the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 apply - known only from a PIB release, not the Gazette. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW OUTSTANDING.
